note: How often each requirement's recurring task is done, read from the register's own words (DECISIONS E-703). For each kind, the recurring task, its hours each time it is done (assumed, as for the kinds in compliance-cost-assumptions.json) and how many times a year it is done when the requirement's words don't say. A requirement's 'what' is searched first, then its title, then the quotes from its law; the first frequency phrase found sets the times a year, unless the words after it show it describes something else ('annual turnover'). Hours each time × the kind's default times a year equal the kind's hours each year, so a requirement whose words name no frequency costs what it did before. Drafted by AI-assisted desk research; not yet checked by a person.
approved: Owner, 28 November 2026: chose 'Calculate first, source to check' (hours from the register first, sources to check)
